newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index drifts lower.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index drifts lower.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 0.64 points, or 0.88 percent, at 72.10 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended 25.29 points or 0.75 percent down at a provisional 3,352.34.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 12.93 percent compared with 11.99 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation-weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
